questions.question: In the early church, some men from Judea taught believers that they could not be saved unless they did what?

answers.text: Get circumcised by the custom of Moses
Offer a sacrifice in the temple

questions.question: When church leaders met in Jerusalem, Peter said God showed His approval of the Gentiles. How did God show it?

answers.text: By giving them the Holy Spirit
By sending them a new prophet
By healing all of their sick

questions.question: Peter told the church leaders in Jerusalem that Jewish believers are saved just as Gentiles are. How are they saved?

answers.text: Through the grace of the Lord Jesus
Through keeping the law of Moses
Through being the sons of Abraham

questions.question: James judged that Gentiles who were turning to God should be required to keep the whole law of Moses. True or false?
